description: This file defines the Operations class with static methods for performing arithmetic operations (add, divideby, divideinto, multiply, subtract) on complex numbers, including input validation and exception handling.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for complex number arithmetic operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two or more complex numbers, returning a new Complex instance.

methods.name: divideby
methods.description: Divides the first complex number by each subsequent complex number in sequence.

methods.name: divideinto
methods.description: Divides each subsequent complex number into the first complex number in sequence.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies two or more complex numbers, returning a new Complex instance.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts multiple complex numbers from the first one.
